card.one_sentence_claim: Under an exact declared symmetry G, no equivariant deterministic selector can pick one element of a nontrivial degenerate orbit (it can only select common G-fixed points); a selectedness predicate descends to the orbit quotient iff the split-pair obstruction O_s is empty, so any spontaneous-symmetry-breaking account must structurally import a declared breaker, and an actually broken branch can only be typed as a formation record once that (undischarged) breaker source is declared.
card.target_known_fact: Spontaneous symmetry breaking and vacuum selection: an exactly symmetric theory has a degenerate, symmetry-related family of ground states, nature selects one (a vacuum / order-parameter direction), and the symmetry is realized only by relating the degenerate options (Goldstone modes; BEC U(1) phase, ferromagnet magnetization, chiral selection). Includes the standard impossibility of selecting a vacuum by symmetric means alone (Buridan's ass, Schelling focal points, Gribov-Singer/Faddeev-Popov gauge-fixing obstruction, hairy-ball / Poincare-Hopf).
card.scientific_domain: Condensed matter / QFT / cosmology (symmetry emergence and its breaking); cross-domain: gauge theory, decision theory, game theory, differential topology, chemistry/origin-of-life.

Lean-certified Symmetry.SelectionObstruction.selection_obstruction, status 'faithful'.
theory_basis.role: Primary engine: the genuine, fully-proved no-go half. Provides the 'exact symmetry cannot select a vacuum without a breaker' content and the exact obstruction set.

Lean Symmetry.Anomaly.anomaly_symmetry_obstruction, 'faithful'.

card.minimum_viable_result: A single faithful proposition + worked toy instance: 'Under an exact declared symmetry G acting with a nontrivial degenerate ground-state orbit, no equivariant deterministic selector picks a single vacuum (it can only return the common G-fixed/symmetric state); selectedness descends to the orbit quotient iff the split-pair obstruction O_s is empty, hence vacuum selection structurally requires a declared breaker.' This is ALREADY Lean-certified faithful as thm:F15a / selection_obstruction; the only new work is Step 7 (one explicit finite instantiation, e.g. U(1) phase on a ring) plus the physics-faithful mapping lemma. It recovers the well-known impossibility of symmetric vacuum selection and unifies it with Buridan/Schelling/Gribov-Singer/hairy-ball. NO F15b, no formation source, no continuum needed.
card.baseline_comparison: MIXED, and honest about it. The no-go half (F15a) does NOT beat the standard account on physics content -- it RECOVERS the long-known impossibility of symmetric vacuum selection (already implicit in Goldstone/Anderson and explicit in Gribov-Singer). What it genuinely REORGANIZES is the LEVEL of generality and the audit: F15a gives one Lean-certified split-pair criterion (O_s empty?) that simultaneously subsumes vacuum selection, gauge-fixing obstructions, Buridan's ass, Schelling focal points, the hairy-ball theorem, and the Vitali/AC construction, and it makes the smuggled-in 'breaker' an explicit, named, minimal piece of data (via the F2 repair normal form). The FORMATION half (F15b) does STRICTLY WORSE: it only TYPES a broken branch conditional on an undischarged opaque source and produces no Goldstone modes, no effective potential, no order-parameter dynamics, and no prediction of which vacuum is realized.
card.why_scientists_care: It converts a folklore intuition -- 'a symmetry cannot break itself; something has to choose' -- into a precise, Lean-certified, domain-general theorem with an explicit obstruction set (O_s) and an explicit minimal repair (the declared breaker). For a physicist it makes auditable exactly which extra datum any SSB / gauge-fixing / measure-selection story must import; the F40 descent test additionally separates symmetries that survive to the macro layer from those that become anomalous. For a foundations/methodology audience it unifies vacuum selection with Gribov-Singer, Buridan's ass, Schelling focal points, the hairy-ball theorem, and the axiom of choice under one finite criterion.

opposite_world_test.explanation: Two-part verdict. (a) The strong, genuine no-go (F15a) is NOT opposite-world-flexible: it is a Lean-faithful theorem that an equivariant deterministic selector under trivial orbit action lands ONLY in the common G-fixed locus, so SBT could NOT have retrodicted the opposite (a symmetric rule cleanly selecting one element of a nontrivial degenerate orbit); this rigidity is the result's strength. (b) BUT the schema as a whole IS opposite-world-flexible through its declared inputs: the breaker b is a free declaration, so whatever vacuum/chirality/axis nature selected (or no breaking at all, by withholding the source) is post-hoc named 'the declared breaker' and F15b's opaque source types it as a formation record. The impossibility direction is rigid and falsifiable-in-principle; the selection/formation direction is fully post-hoc.

audit.audit_verdict: SPLIT VERDICT, low overfitting risk, honest card. NO-GO HALF (F15a Selection Obstruction): a genuine, Lean-certified 'faithful' theorem (Symmetry.SelectionObstruction.selection_obstruction, statTheorem; verified at thm:F15a lines 3038-3107 of Foundations IV). Elementary equivariance/descent algebra, contentful only relative to a declared symmetry group G, breaker b, and lens (all underived inputs). RECOVERS, not predicts, the long-known impossibility of symmetric vacuum selection; value-add is cross-domain unification under one split-pair criterion O_s=empty (mechanism reused in R018 Noether, R019 gauge/OI-EI, R031 anomaly/F40). Zero quantitative data points matched. FORMATION HALF (F15b): obligation wrapper (statObligation, needs-strengthening) over the opaque FutureBranchSelectionFormationSource that axiomatizes its own conclusion; per subsec:narrowing-disclosure NO completed substrate paper is cited as discharge. TYPES a broken branch once a breaker is declared but DERIVES no formation, no Goldstone modes, no effective potential. DISCLAIMERS HONORED. DEFENSIBLE CLAIM: strictly the F15a no-go + F2 repair normal form as a sharp, domain-general honesty audit naming exactly which datum (the declared breaker) every SSB/gauge-fixing/measure-selection account must import.
